scope: Post-inspection development diagnostic; no final test, gate, deployment model selection or language-generalization claim
language_input: Recorded three-task identity only; no instruction embedding in this archive
support: Primary matched offline comparison: complete eight-candidate physical endpoint50 bank with no success during either prefix; report all exclusions. This outcome-dependent subset is not representative deployment performance.
features: Current visual and mean proprio latent, current raw four-value proprio, task one-hot, remaining horizon; direct adds executed action prefix; future adds endpoint visual/proprio latent using the same fixed channel map. Spatial pools16x16 to4x4; global averages16x16.
extra_transfer: Apply each actual-trained head to predicted features without refitting
family: Episode-weighted ridge regression of three-repeat mean success, train-only weighted normalization, clipped probabilities
main_folds: Leave one whole seed cluster out; pilot never trains or selects a main head; report each fold and combined main out-of-fold predictions
pilot_evaluation: Supplementary: train on both main seed clusters, evaluate pilot seed26 separately; not a new untouched test
tie_rule: Scores within1e-10 of maximum choose smallest candidate index including reference
metrics: Episode-weighted per-repeat Brier; selected success/gain/help/harm/regret; informative-bank coverage; informative-pair ordering; full-state fixed controls separately
old_data: Not merged: old ten-action direct dimensions/language embeddings differ, and no old50-action outcomes exist
model_selection: None; report every declared representation/evaluator, do not choose a deployable winner from these inspected development outcomes
